Name: The Winter King from Adventure Time portrait mod (Elliot replacement)
Author: Shovelham
Description:
This is a pretty simple mod, it just changes Elliotts portraits to Winter King. Why? Because I am very normal.

There's really nothing complicated with this mod, just download it and throw it into the mods folder you have and badda bing badaboom

If people really like these portraits I might also make complimentary sprites for that silly lil guy

Thank you so much for downloading this mod if you did! Makes me very flattered<3

Manifest.Name: Winter King Portrait mod
Manifest.Description: Replaces Elliott's portraits with the Winter king.
